verdict.rationale: Jan runs models entirely on your own hardware and states "Zero data collection until you say so," with privacy-first local execution. That lets a user keep conversations off any server where they could be used for training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for model training, documentation of how training policies apply when cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) are connected, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-collection claim.
